policyReview.message: The catalog asks students to choose open electives “taking into consideration the degree program upper-level requirements” but publishes no number for them.
policyReview.question: Ask Columbia Southern: how many upper-level (3000- and 4000-level) credits does this degree require? Its catalog refers to “the degree program upper-level requirements” for open electives but doesn’t give a number.
